The Hong Kong Jockey Club

Job description:

The Hong Kong Jockey Club

Founded in 1884, The Hong Kong Jockey Club ("the Club") is a world-class racing club that acts continuously for the betterment of our society. The Club has a unique integrated business model, comprising racing and racecourse entertainment, a membership club, responsible sports wagering and lottery, and charities and community contribution. Through this model, the Club generates economic and social value for the community and supports the HKSAR Government in combatting illegal gambling.

The Division

The Corporate Affairs (CA) Division strengthens the strategic development and positioning of the Club as a world-class racing club and charity organisation, through engaging key stakeholders in both Hong Kong and the Mainland, and maintaining efficient and effective corporate communications.​​​

Job Summary

The job holder contributes to strengthen the strategic development and positioning of the Club as a world-class racing club, charitable and sports organisation, through engaging key stakeholders. The job holder also assists in formulating and executing stakeholder engagement strategies to build up relationships with the Government, political parties, different tiers of councils, key district and community stakeholders, as well as supporting the Club's betting businesses. The job holder's responsibilities may include preparing materials for meetings with stakeholders, advising on event attendance, and coaching team members.

The Job
Assist in developing and implementing comprehensive stakeholder engagement strategies to develop an effective and reliable network of relationship with stakeholders, including government officials, members of different tiers of councils (i.e. Legislative Council and District Councils), political parties' members, district and community stakeholders.
Assist in organising stakeholder engagement activities, briefings, meetings and/or volunteer programmes for government officials, council members, political parties' members, district stakeholders or other external and community stakeholders in support of the Club's initiatives, operations and related businesses.
Prepare written and presentation materials for the abovementioned engagement activities as and when appropriate.
Assist in handling sponsorship applications and overseeing the execution of sponsored projects and events.
Advise seniors on attendance of stakeholder engagement activities, Club's sponsored projects and events in accordance with relevant district event protocols and local political climate and coach junior team members as and when appropriate.
Ensure compliance with Responsible Gambling Policy (RGP) and all stipulated legal requirements pertaining to wagering, thereby protecting the integrity of the Club's business
Undertake other duties as assigned by supervisors.

A recognised university degree in communications, public relations, public administration, business studies, external affairs and/or any other related discipline
A minimum of 3-6 years' experience working in corporate communications, external relations, government relations, public relations, community engagement, media management and/or journalism, NGOs
Established network with RG-related external stakeholders and solid project management experience would be an advantage

title: Education Operations Coordinator/Assistant
snippet: Education Operations Coordinator: top-notch admin & operations, AI-savvy, calm under pressure, big heart. Keep our education team running smoothly
label: 运营
full_jd:
About the Role

This is a hands on operational role for someone who genuinely loves making things run well. Reporting directly to and working closely with the Education Manager, you will handle messages, keep lessons on track, fix problems calmly when they arise, and build the systems and trackers that keep everything organised — so the Manager can focus on the bigger picture and genuinely step away when needed.

We also want someone who uses modern tools, including AI, not just to answer the odd question but to actively streamline workflows, automate repetitive work, and save the team time. A good understanding of our courses, UK admissions and exams is essential so you can act with context and confidence.

Key Responsibilities

Messages & Communication

Act as a reliable point of contact across our communication channels (WhatsApp & email), responding promptly, warmly and professionally.

Triage and prioritise incoming messages — handling the majority directly and escalating only what genuinely needs management.

Communicate clearly with tutors and parents to arrange, confirm and reschedule lessons and consultations.

Live Lesson Support

Keep an eye on scheduled lessons and step in quickly when something goes wrong: technical issues, tutor or student no-shows, last-minute changes.

Be reachable during scheduled lesson times (checked daily via the lesson calendar) to resolve issues fast, on a rotating basis shared with other team members — so coverage never depends on any one person.

Troubleshoot calmly and follow clear escalation guidelines for genuine emergencies.

Administration, Systems & Records

Own the department’s day-to-day admin: scheduling, documents, records, follow-ups and reminders, so nothing slips.

Build, maintain and improve tracking spreadsheets: enquiry and lead tracking, lesson-hour records, billing reconciliation and similar.

Keep data clean, accurate and well-organised across our systems and trackers.

AI & Workflow Improvement

Use AI tools practically to streamline and speed up everyday work: drafting, summarising, organising information, and checking data.

Identify repetitive or manual processes and improve or automate them, including building smarter spreadsheets and trackers.

Help raise the whole team’s efficiency by sharing and applying better tools and workflows.

What We're Looking For

1+ years in a strong administrative, operations or coordination role. You are exceptionally organised, accurate and dependable.

Demonstrated, practical use of AI tools to improve real work — not just asking chatbots questions, but using them to streamline workflows, build or check spreadsheets, and save time. (Be ready to give a concrete example at interview.)

Genuinely strong with spreadsheets (Excel / Google Sheets) — comfortable with formulas, tracking systems and clean data structures.

Good understanding of education / UK admissions and exams (boarding schools, interviews, UKiset / ISEB / CAT4 and similar) — or the ability to learn our offering quickly and thoroughly.

Excellent written and spoken English; Cantonese and/or Mandarin highly advantageous given our client base.

Calm and resourceful under pressure — you solve problems rather than escalate them, and you exercise sound judgement on what to handle versus flag.

Responsible, conscientious and not afraid of hard work — you take ownership, you care about doing things properly, and you genuinely have heart for the people you support.

Comfortable being reachable during scheduled lesson times , including some evenings, weekends and public holidays.

Working Pattern

Schedule: Five-day working week. Lesson-time coverage is scoped to the actual lesson schedule (checked daily). Working on Saturdays & Sundays is a MUST. Please only apply if this is fine with you.

Benefits: Annual leave, medical insurance, MPF, and visa sponsorship for the right candidate.

What We Offer

A genuine learning environment: you will work closely with the Education Manager and gain real exposure to UK boarding-school admissions, interviews and entrance exams.

Hands-on experience with modern tools, including AI, that you can use to sharpen your own skills and make your work easier.

Mentorship and close support from experienced colleagues in a small, collaborative team where your work genuinely matters.

A stable, valued role in a growing, premium education consultancy — a place to do meaningful work and be appreciated for it.

To apply, please send your CV and a short note on a process or tool you have improved (bonus points if it involved AI or a spreadsheet you built) to cou••••@academic-asia.com.

full_jd:
Clarivate is seeking a Senior Consultant to join our Academic and Government Consulting team within the Research & Analytics business unit. With a focus on Hong Kong, Macau, and selected English-speaking markets, in this role you will be working with colleagues to cultivate strong relationships with our clients and help universities, research institutes, and governments to develop and implement their strategic plans and approaches in research and education. Working in collaboration with Product, Sales, Marketing, and other Consulting practice areas. To support business growth in above markets by delivering high-quality consulting projects and enabling pre-sales. The role requires a combination of analytical capability, client engagement, and strong storytelling to produce client-ready outputs. 

If you are a forward thinker and have a strong understanding of research tools and delivering innovative solutions to clients, we would love to speak with you.   

About You – experience, education, skills, and accomplishments. 

PhD (STEM disciplines preferred) 

Above 5 years of experience in consulting / research analytics / policy research 

Strong analytical skills with the ability to generate insights, complemented by strong qualitative thinking and analyzing to interpret context and develop compelling narratives 

Excellent English writing skills, with the ability to produce polished, client-ready outputs (critical) 

Proven experience in client-facing roles, with strong communication and stakeholder management skills 

Ability to translate data into clear, structured insights and differentiated narratives 

Strong sense of ownership, with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment 

Fluent in English and Mandarin (written and spoken) 

It would be great if you also had . . . 

Experience working with academic institutions or government clients 

Familiarity with bibliometrics, research evaluation, or policy analysis 

Experience developing case studies or externally published reports (e.g., white papers) 

Ability to combine quantitative analysis with contextual research to enrich insights 

Cantonese proficiency 

Based in (or willing to relocate to) the Greater Bay Area 

What will you be doing in this role? 

The position offers challenging hypothesis-driven projects for professionals with a scientific background and leadership experience around data-driven science management. The Senior Consultant will have responsibilities that include, but are not limited to: 

Support pre-sales by shaping opportunities, developing proposals, and engaging with clients 

Work closely with Sales to understand client needs and define project scope and approach 

Deliver consulting projects end-to-end (analysis → insight generation → reporting) 

Conduct data analysis (e.g., research performance, benchmarking) and translate findings into actionable insights 

Develop high-quality, structured, and externally presentable deliverables 

Identify key highlights and craft compelling, client-facing narratives from complex datasets 

Integrate data analysis with desk research and contextual information to strengthen outputs 

Manage multiple projects and deliver high-quality work under tight timelines 

About the Team 

Clarivate’s Academic and Government Consulting is a diverse group of practitioners working across the global delivering consulting revenue globally. The Academic and Government Consulting group is made up of three practice areas: Research Analytics, Research Excellence, Reputation, and Evaluation & Assessment. Across our practice areas, there is also a wide range of skill sets (e.g., data scientists, bibliometricians, visualisation specialists, analysts, etc). Across our different practice areas there is also a wider variety of capabilities and services we provide to clients along with different commercial and go-to-market models. 

Hours of Work 

This role is based in the Greater China and is a full-time, hybrid position, primarily working core business hours in your time zone, with flexibility to adjust to various global time zones as needed.

Job Brief

Join All About You Wellness Centre, Hong Kong’s leading wellness hub dedicated to mental health and hypnotherapy. We are looking for a versatile, dependable, and self-motivated Marketing & Admin Assistant.

In this dual-capacity role, and a key driver of our growth. You will balance administrative excellence with creative marketing strategies, ensuring a seamless experience for our clients and practitioners. This is a pivotal role for someone passionate about personal development and making a tangible difference in people's lives.About the role

We are looking for a dedicated and enthusiastic Marketing Assistant to join our dynamic team at All About You', a Key Responsibilities

1. Marketing Tasks

Strategy & Sales: Support ideas for business growth; promote workshops, products and services to new and existing clients; follow up with potential leads.

Content Creation: Use creative writing to develop material for newsletters on Mailerlite and marketing collateral; design graphics and promotional materials using Canva.

Social Media: Handle and create social media posts on all our communities across all platforms including Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp.

Database Updation: Maintaining and updating client records and databases across platforms

Website Management: Maintain and update the company website using WordPress.

Events: Coordinate workshops and company events (onsite and offsite) Handle registrations, enquiries, and venue set-up.

2. Center Administration & Operations

Reception: Manage the front desk, handle phone calls/emails, and welcome participants with empathy and professionalism.

Liaison: Coordinate with local and overseas practitioners regarding schedules, bookings, and private sessions.

Office Management: Manage appointments and scheduling via centre’s booking system; maintain client records and databases; oversee product/service sales.

Support: Provide administrative assistance to the Founder and Operations Manager; and manage ad-hoc office duties.

Environment: Ensure the center’s cleanliness and tidiness before and after sessions; prepare necessary paperwork and amenities.

Requirements

Experience: Proven experience in marketing, office administration, reception. Previous experience in a wellness or mental health environment is a plus.

Technical Skills: 

Well versed with Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, SEO management 

Proficient in WordPress (website updates).

Working knowledge of design software  Canva

Advanced proficiency in G Suite (Gmail, Docs, Calendar.)

Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with high email etiquette.

Soft Skills: Strong organizational and leadership skills; ability to multitask ("wear many hats"); proactive and resourceful problem-solver.

Mindset: Strategic & creative thinker who can take initiative, handle projects independently. A positive, self-motivated attitude with a genuine interest in personal development and mental health.

This Job is Right for You If:

You are a "people person" who enjoys building relationships.

You are flexible with your schedule—staying late or starting late occasionally to accommodate center events.

You thrive in a dual-responsibility role (Sales/Marketing + Operations).

You are eager to learn and grow within the wellness industry.

Perks & Benefits

Free Training: Complimentary access to Sonia Samtani’s workshops

Discounts: Staff discounts on all workshops, self-development books, and crystals.

Environment: A workplace that genuinely values your mental health and professional advancement.

Learning and Development: Room to take initiative, grow your people  skills, learn about yourself.
